business_overview.one_sentence: The group designs, manufactures and distributes small wooden handicrafts and accessories under the Carpenter Tan brand, mainly through PRC franchise/offline and online channels, with small direct retail and property investment activities.

segments.business_substance: Online distribution of wooden handicrafts and accessories.
Franchise/distribution network product sales, mainly in the PRC.
Direct retail outlets in Hong Kong, Singapore and the PRC.

business_overview.revenue_model: Point-in-time product sales; franchisees generally pay before delivery, with limited 30-day credit to selected customers.
business_notes: At 31 December 2025 the group had 1,307 franchised stores and 5 directly-operated outlets.
Box sets contributed RMB513.013 million, or 91.9% of 2025 revenue.

non_recurring_items.business_substance: One-off derecognition of Jurong, Jiangsu property after final court ruling.
non_recurring_items.source: 2025 Annual Report Note 14(A), pp.117-118; Note 7(B), p.109

non_recurring_items.business_substance: Return on funds assets; excluded from operating cash profit when the related principal is treated as detachable.

non_recurring_items.business_substance: Fair value gain on principal-guaranteed wealth management products.

funds_assets.business_substance: Cash and cash equivalents; RMB76.212 million of cash and bank balances were placed with banks in Mainland China.

funds_assets.source: 2025 Annual Report Statement of Financial Position, p.77; Note 23(A), p.132

funds_assets.business_substance: Long-term non-pledged bank deposits; total fixed bank deposits placed with Mainland China banks were RMB346.000 million.
funds_assets.source: 2025 Annual Report Statement of Financial Position, p.77; Note 23(A), p.132

funds_assets.item: Financial assets at fair value through profit or loss
funds_assets.business_substance: Principal-guaranteed wealth management products issued by PRC banks, expected return 1.28%-2.22%, Level 3 FVPL.
funds_assets.source: 2025 Annual Report Note 21, p.129; Note 30(C), pp.143-144

operating_assets.business_substance: Raw materials, work-in-progress and finished goods; RMB166.816 million raw materials expected to be recovered after more than twelve months.
Credit sales receivables; customers generally pay before delivery or within 30 days.
Buildings, leasehold improvements, plant/equipment and construction in progress for production and operations.

investment_assets.business_substance: PRC residential and commercial properties leased out under operating leases.

other_assets.business_substance: Prepayments, deposits, other receivables and tax recoverables.

financing_liabilities.business_substance: The group had no interest-bearing bank borrowings at 31 December 2025.
financing_liabilities.source: 2025 Annual Report Management Discussion and Analysis, p.40

operating_liabilities.business_substance: Salary payable, other payables/accruals, sales return provision, VAT/non-income tax payables, trade deposits and contract liabilities.
Operating property leases for warehouses, retail stores and production complex land; treated through cash-profit quality rather than deducted as detachable-cash financing debt.
operating_liabilities.source: 2025 Annual Report Note 26, p.135; Note 14(B), pp.118-120

other_liabilities.business_substance: Deferred tax liabilities mainly from revaluation/fair value and lease timing differences.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Profit has been stable in 2023-2025. Full cash flow detail was extracted for 2024-2025; 2025 operating cash flow exceeded reported profit, while 2024 was lower after inventory build and capex. The 2025 derecognition loss is non-cash and non-recurring. Cash-profit conversion is usable but discounted for inventory size, prepayment increase, limited 2023 cash-flow extraction and PRC cash remittance friction.

gaps: The annual report does not split cash and deposits by parent company versus each subsidiary; it only discloses Mainland China placement amounts.
Full 2023 operating cash flow and capital expenditure were not extracted from this 2025 annual report; 2023 profit is available from the five-year summary.
The exact maturity ladder inside the over-one-year fixed deposits is not disclosed beyond the balance sheet classification.
